# FlowChartPalette

**Class:** `UltraCanvasFlowChartPalette` · **Group:** [Diagrams](../Groups/Diagrams.md) · **Header:** [`UltraCanvas/include/Plugins/Diagrams/UltraCanvasFlowChartPalette.h`](../../../UltraCanvas/include/Plugins/Diagrams/UltraCanvasFlowChartPalette.h) · `#include "Plugins/Diagrams/UltraCanvasFlowChartPalette.h"`

Boxes and arrows: a flow chart (with a shape palette for editing)

## Creating it

Factory functions (the usual way - every element is held in a `std::shared_ptr`):

```cpp
std::shared_ptr<UltraCanvasFlowChartPalette> CreateFlowChartPalette( const std::string& id, int x, int y, int width, int height);
```

Constructors:

```cpp
UltraCanvasFlowChartPalette(const std::string& id, int x, int y, int width, int height);
```

The first string argument is always the element's **identifier**, never its text (see [Core concepts](../Core-Concepts.md#identifiers)).
